title: Python SDK Log Streaming helpers: client types, log formats and status codes

prose.text: These are claims about the Python SDK's LSS receiver helpers. The source log type map is in [[zpa.log-receivers.log-types]].

checks.do: Whether a receiver create failed on a helper that returned None, since the helpers hide the error and the create then fails inside the SDK.
Whether a client_type rule used the display names the lookup builds (lower-case, underscores).

client-types-call.statement: `get_client_types` makes a GET to the `clientTypes` path under the LSS config endpoint, and returns a map from each display name, lower-cased with spaces turned to underscores, to its code; it is an API call, not a built-in table.

quotes: reverse_map = {v.lower().replace(" ", "_"): k for k, v in client_types.items()}
reverse_map = {v.lower().replace(" ", "_"): k for k, v in client_types.items()}

client-types-client-type-rule.statement: Building an LSS policy rule with a `client_type` condition calls `get_client_types()` once for each client-type value in the condition and looks the value up in the result, so each value costs an extra request. When that lookup fails, `get_client_types` returns None and the subscript raises TypeError.
client-types-client-type-rule.conditions: Corrected from one extra request per rule to one per value, and the failure case added; previously "Building an LSS policy rule with a `client_type` condition calls `get_client_types()` and looks each name up in the result, so each such rule costs an extra request."

helpers-bare-return.statement: `get_client_types`, `get_all_log_formats` and `get_status_codes` return a dictionary or None, not the usual three-element tuple, and return None when the request cannot be built or fails.

add-fetches-default-format.statement: `add_lss_config` takes the receiver format from `log_stream_content` if given and otherwise fetches all log formats and indexes them by source log code and `source_log_format`, which defaults to csv; if that fetch returned None the indexing fails inside the SDK.

add-fetches-default-format.conditions: The failure on None follows from subscripting the return value; it was not run.

add-policy-set-lookup.statement: When `policy_rules` is given, `add_lss_config` looks up the SIEM_POLICY policy set and puts its ID in the rule's `policySetId`; the rule name defaults to SIEM_POLICY.

status-codes-filter.statement: `get_status_codes` with a log type other than all keeps the codes whose `log_types` include the source log code mapped from that key, and raises ValueError for a key not in the source log map.
